title: The 17-Year-Old Who Hacked Twitter
sources: Reuters, July 15 2020: hackers took over 130 high-profile Twitter accounts (Obama, Biden, Musk, Gates, Apple, Kanye West) with the same bitcoin-doubling scam, and Twitter blocked verified accounts from tweeting while it fixed the breach

US Department of Justice, July 31 2020: Graham Ivan Clark, 17, of Tampa, Florida, was charged as the mastermind; he gained access by phone spear-phishing (vishing) Twitter employees, then used an internal admin tool to take over accounts; about $117,000 (12.86 BTC) was collected
US Department of Justice / court records, March 2021: Clark pleaded guilty to 30 counts and was sentenced to three years in a juvenile facility

lines.text: One July afternoon in twenty twenty, Barack Obama tweeted he was giving away money.
So did Elon Musk, Bill Gates, and Apple.
It was a seventeen-year-old kid from Florida.
and he didn't write a single line of malware.
He called Twitter employees, pretending to be from the IT department,
lines.caps: HE CALLED *TWITTER | PRETENDING TO BE | FROM THE *IT DEPARTMENT

lines.text: and asked for their login credentials.
One of them typed it in.
That gave him the internal admin tool,
lines.caps: THAT GAVE HIM | THE INTERNAL | *ADMIN TOOL

lines.text: the one that controls every account on the platform.
In minutes, a hundred and thirty of the world's biggest accounts were posting the same scam,
and about a hundred and seventeen thousand dollars poured in.
But here's the part people miss.
So remember, the strongest firewall in the world
is still a human being who answers the phone.
lines.caps: IS STILL A | *HUMAN BEING | WHO ANSWERS | THE *PHONE
